name: 漿果叢

pages.text: 群巒生活模組新增了一些漿果叢。關於野生葡萄藤的資訊，請參閱$(l:firmalife/wine)釀酒$()指南。

First is nightshade. Nightshade is a poisonous berry. When put into soup, it makes poisonous $(thing)Stinky Soup$(). It is found between 200-400mm of rain and temperatures of $(cfg:temperature:7) to $(cfg:temperature:24) in forests. It bears fruit in the month of $(thing)August$(), flowering the month prior.$(br2)Conditions required for growth:$(br)$(bold)$(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): $(flcfg:climate.nightshade.temperature)$(br)$(bold)$(l:food/hydration)Hydration$(): $(flcfg:climate.nightshade.hydration)%

Pineapple bushes are found 250-500mm of rainfall and temperatures of $(cfg:temperature:20) to $(cfg:temperature:32) in forests. They bear fruit in the month of $(thing)September$(), flowering the two months prior.$(br2)Conditions required for growth:$(br)$(bold)$(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): $(flcfg:climate.pineapple.temperature)$(br)$(bold)$(l:food/hydration)Hydration$(): $(flcfg:climate.pineapple.hydration)% Pineapples are like any other fruit, except that they can be made into $(thing)Pineapple Leather$().
$(l:tfc:firmalife/drying)曬乾$()的菠蘿能被製成菠蘿纖維。
菠蘿線是透過使用$(thing)紡錘$()與菠蘿纖維合成得到的。
最後，菠蘿布能在$(l:tfc:mechanics/weaving)織機$()中被加工。它是普通皮革的植物替代品，可用於裝飾、合成或其他用途！
